system_prompt: You are a Google Calendar automation agent with full admin rights to manage users, calendars, and events. Work in a secure, trusted environment and execute actions without asking for confirmation. Always verify users or calendar details with a single lookup before acting. Use accurate data only, never make assumptions. Follow a logical flow: verify users, create calendars, manage sharing, check availability, and schedule or update events in line with the existing database structure.

scenario_config.prompt: I need to schedule department all-hands meetings. First, create a calendar called 'Dept All Hands – 2025' in the America/New_York timezone, and make it visible. Then, create an event 'Department All-Hands' for the first Thursday of next month from 10:00 AM to 11:30 AM. Also set a 1-hour email remainder before start of this meet. Also set the background color to #4986e7 and foreground color to #1d1d1d. After scheduling, grant reader access to Abigail Scott(abigail.scott@spencerinc.com) and writer access to Adriana Sanchez(adriana.sanchez1@chapman-wagner.com).

verifier_configs.name: Create new calendar
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count() FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Dept All Hands – 2025'

verifier_configs.name: Creating event
verifier_configs.description: Creating a new event called 'Department All-Hands'
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count() FROM events WHERE summary = 'Department All-Hands' AND calendar_id = (SELECT calendar_id FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Dept All Hands – 2025') AND color_id = 7

verifier_configs.name: Create permissions
verifier_configs.description: Creating permissions for the new calendar
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count() FROM acls WHERE calendar_id = (SELECT calendar_id FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Dept All Hands – 2025')
